paite: Huaiziak in Pathian zahngaihna a hiai nasepna mu in ka lungke kei uhi.
heading: Leibel Ah Vangou Kem
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

paite: Thil zumhuai kiselte ka pampaih zawta ua, khemna thu ka zang kei ua, Pathian thu tuh mi khemna ding in ka zang kei ua, thutak theisak in Pathian mitmuh in michih sia-le-pha theihna mit ka tungsak uhi.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

paite: Himahleh ka tanchinhoih uh khuh a a-omleh, mangthang lelte ah ahi khuh a a-om.
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

paite: Pathian batpih Khrist leh athupidan tanchinhoih vak in amau asalhvak theihlouhna ding in, huaite ah hiai khovel pathian in agingtaloute lungsim asukmialsakta hi.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

paite: Koumau thu ka gen kei ua, Khrist Jesu Toupa thu ka gen zaw uhi, koute leng Jesu ziak in sikha ka hih uh leng ka gen zel uhi.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,

paite: Jesu Khrist mel ah Pathian thupidan theihna vak hon pe ding in, "Mial a kipan vak avakkhe ding," chipa Pathian in i lungtangte asalvakta ngal hi.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

paite: Himahleh thilhihtheihna thupina koute a hilou a, Pathian a ahihtheih zawkna ding in huai gou tuh leibel ah ka kem uhi.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

paite: Alanglang ah nehden in ka om ua, himahleh ning kitel in ka om tuan kei uh; mangbang in ka om ua himahleh ka lungke tuan kei uhi.
heading: Khrist A Pathian Hatna
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

paite: Sawi in ka om ua, himahleh taisan in ka om kei uh; khetpuk in ka om ua, himahleh hihmang in ka om kei uh.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

paite: Ka pumpi uah chik lai peuh in leng Jesu sihna ka pu zel ua, Jesu hinna leng ka pumpi ua alattheihna ding in.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

paite: Koute hingdam a omlaite Jesu ziak a si ding a matsak in ka om gige ua Jesu hinna leng ka sa sithei ua a lattheihna ding in.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

paite: Huchi in koute ah sihna in asem gige a, nou ah bel hinna in asem gige hi.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

paite: Himahleh, "Ka ging a, huaiziak in thu ka gen ahi," chih gelhpa ginna lungsim ngei pu in, kou leng ka ging ua, thu leng ka gen uhi.
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

paite: Toupa Jesu kaithoupa'n koute leng Jesu ah hon kaithou sam ding a, noumau toh ama omna mun ah hon dingsak ding chih thei in.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

paite: Bangkim noumau hoihna ding ahi ngal a, hehpihna mi tamzaw ziak a hihkhan a om a, Pathian thupina ding a kipahthu genna nakpitak a akhansak sem theihna ding in.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

paite: Huai thu ziak in ka bah kei uhi; i polam mihing zawngkhal hiaihiai mahleh, i sunglam mihing pen niteng in bawl thak zel in a-om zaw ahi.
heading: Pumpi Khat A Hinna Nih
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

paite: Ka gimthuakna neukha uh tu mitphiat kal sung kia a om ding in, thupina thupitak tangtawn a ding in ahon bawlsak hulhul ahi.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

paite: Thil muhtheihte en lou in, thil muh theihlouhte ka en zaw uhi; thil muhtheihte zaw sawt lou kal a ding ahi a, thil muh theihlouhte bel tangtawn a ding ahi zaw hi.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
